site.title: Apps by Ashwin Gopalsamy
site.description: Apps, sites and tools built by Ashwin Gopalsamy, from macOS menu bar utilities to data atlases and editor themes.
headline: Small annoyances,
fixed.

apps.name: Atomberg Console
apps.annoyance: Your fan has a remote. You have no idea where it is.
apps.description: A macOS menu bar app for Atomberg fans, purifiers and locks.

apps.name: Dell Monitor Console
apps.annoyance: Dell's Display Manager: a whole app for one slider.
apps.description: A lite macOS menu bar app for the brightness of your Dell and other DDC/CI displays.

apps.name: Claude Code Theme
apps.annoyance: Your editor is a flashbang at 2 a.m.
apps.description: Calm colour themes for long sessions in VS Code, Cursor and Windsurf. Ten flavors, bold or not.

apps.name: Policy Rate Atlas
apps.annoyance: Central bank rates live on seven websites, in seven formats.
apps.description: Seven economies, every rate change and decision, checked against each bank's own publications.

apps.name: Pismo Zones
apps.annoyance: It's always 3 a.m. for someone on your team.
apps.description: What time is it for the team? Every office's local time, working state and daylight, and any moment converted.

apps.name: Agam
apps.annoyance: Every home build ends with "where did the money go?"
apps.description: A construction journal for a home taking shape in Tamil Nadu: money spent, work done and the crew on each recorded day.

apps.name: MKKS Organics
apps.annoyance: Supermarket mangoes taste like a rumour.
